svg.aria-label: Grouped evaluation. Each of the overlapping subdomains gathers only the points inside it, all 75 networks run in one vmap call, segment_sum adds the pieces back per point so a point shared by two subdomains gets two contributions added, and the sum is divided by the summed windows. A dense points by subdomains copy would be 75 × 262,144 × 3 × 4 bytes, about 236 MB, while the grouped layout stores flat point and subdomain pairs, points times overlap with no padding, next to an x_batch of about 3 MB.
svg.text: a shared point gets two pieces, added
